Four of five return, including the fix that worked: pass defense 'improved dramatically' after Hamilton's midseason move to safety (Athlon), and he led the secondary with 3 INT (CFN); Sessi (81 tkl, signal-caller, captain) anchors.
Raw grades stay modest (Sessi/Hamilton 62.7 at 750+ snaps; Oniha 70.0/399 the best) from a 15th-pctile as-played unit; losses are absorbable (Ross 57.1 to Virginia, Campbell 67.7).

The punter is a proven weapon: Carlson 44.5 avg as a freshman-season starter (Athlon 2026); academy coverage culture behind him.
The kicker is the risk: Welch (SO, no attempts) replaces Kirkwood's precision season (53-53 XP, 10-11 FG - CFN) on a team that wins close games.
2025 team SPEC 75.2; 55 = above average on the punter/coverage floor, capped by the unproven K.
